v2Mcp.authToolDescription: Authenticate with MCP server "{{serverName}}" via OAuth
v2Mcp.authToolDescriptionBlock:
This server requires an OAuth login that has not yet been completed. Calling this tool starts the authorization flow:

1. The tool prints an authorization URL.
2. **You must show that URL to the user verbatim** and ask them to open it in a browser, sign in, and approve the kimi-code client.
3. The tool blocks (up to {{timeoutMinutes}} minutes) until the browser redirects back to the local callback listener.
4. On success, kimi-code reconnects the MCP server and the real tools replace this synthetic tool.

Take no arguments. Treat the URL as sensitive — do not modify it or strip query parameters.
v2Mcp.authTimeoutSuffix: (timeout {{timeoutMinutes}} min). If you cancel, call this tool again to restart the flow.
v2Mcp.authErrorUrlSuffix: Authorization URL (still valid if the listener has not timed out): {{authorizationUrl}}

v2Mcp.authenticated: MCP server "{{serverName}}" authenticated successfully. The real MCP tools have replaced this synthetic authenticate tool.

program.description: The Starting Point for Next-Gen Agents

commandDescriptions.login: Authenticate with Kimi Code CLI via the device-code flow.
commandDescriptions.upgrade: Upgrade Kimi Code to the latest version.
commandDescriptions.web: Run the local Kimi server and open the web UI.
commandDescriptions.exportCmd: Export a session as a ZIP archive.
commandDescriptions.serverRotateToken: Generate a new persistent server token; the previous token stops working immediately.
commandDescriptions.providerAdd: Import every provider listed in a custom registry (api.json).
commandDescriptions.providerRemove: Remove a provider and every model alias that referenced it.
commandDescriptions.providerList: Show configured providers and their model counts.
commandDescriptions.providerCatalog: Discover and import providers from the public models.dev catalog.
commandDescriptions.providerCatalogList: List providers in the catalog, or models when a providerId is given.
commandDescriptions.providerCatalogAdd: Import a known provider from the catalog by id.

optionDescriptions.session: Resume a session. With ID: resume that session. Without ID: interactively pick.
optionDescriptions.continue: Continue the previous session for the working directory.
optionDescriptions.yolo: Start in Ask When Needed mode: routine edits and commands run automatically; risky actions, questions, and plans still ask.
optionDescriptions.auto: Start in Never Ask mode: never interrupts you; everything runs and is decided automatically.
optionDescriptions.model: LLM model alias to use for this invocation. Defaults to default_model in config.toml.
optionDescriptions.prompt: Run one prompt non-interactively and print the response.
optionDescriptions.outputFormat: Output format for prompt mode. Defaults to text.
optionDescriptions.skillsDir: Load skills from this directory instead of auto-discovered user and project directories. Can be repeated.
optionDescriptions.addDir: Add an additional workspace directory for this session. Can be repeated.
optionDescriptions.agent: Agent profile to start the new session with. Custom profiles are discovered from agent directories or loaded via --agent-file. Cannot be combined with --session/--continue.
optionDescriptions.agentFile: Load an agent definition from a Markdown file and select it for the new session. Cannot be combined with --session/--continue.
optionDescriptions.upgradeYes: Skip the confirmation prompt and install the update directly.
optionDescriptions.installDesktop: Print the Kimi Code desktop app page and open it in your browser.
optionDescriptions.exportSessionId: Session id to export. Defaults to the most recent session.
optionDescriptions.exportNoIncludeGlobalLog: Skip bundling the active global diagnostic log (~/.kimi-code/logs/kimi-code.log, not rotated .1 files). By default the global log is included.
optionDescriptions.acpLogin: Run the device-code login flow then exit (entry point for ACP terminal-auth).
optionDescriptions.visPort: Port to bind. Default: auto-pick a free port.
optionDescriptions.visNoOpen: Do not open the browser automatically.
optionDescriptions.doctorConfigPath: Validate this file as config.toml instead of the default path.
optionDescriptions.doctorTuiPath: Validate this file as tui.toml instead of the default path.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionHost: Bind host. Omit for {{host}} (local); pass --host for {{lanHost}} (all interfaces), or --host <host> for a specific address. The bearer token is printed at startup.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionAllowedHost: Extra Host header values to allow through the DNS-rebinding check. Repeatable or comma-separated; a leading dot matches a domain suffix (e.g. .example.com).
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionAllowRemoteShutdown: On a non-loopback bind, keep POST /api/v1/shutdown enabled (default: disabled → 404).
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionAllowRemoteTerminals: On a non-loopback bind, keep PTY /api/v1/terminals/* routes enabled (default: disabled → 404). Remote shell is high risk.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionDangerousBypassAuth: Disable bearer-token auth on all REST and WebSocket routes, and advertise it via /api/v1/meta. Only use on a trusted network or behind your own authenticating proxy.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionLogLevel: Server log level: {{levels}}. Omit to keep logs off.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionDebugEndpoints: Mount /api/v1/debug/* routes for test introspection. OFF by default; production callers leave this unset.
optionDescriptions.serverRunOptionNoOpen: Do not open the web UI in the default browser.
optionDescriptions.providerApiKey: Registry API key. Prefer KIMI_PROVIDER_API_KEY, or pass "-" to read it from stdin; a key given here is visible in the process list.
optionDescriptions.providerListJson: Emit the raw providers/models config as JSON.
optionDescriptions.providerCatalogJson: Emit the matching catalog slice as JSON.
optionDescriptions.providerCatalogApiKey: API key for the provider. Prefer KIMI_PROVIDER_API_KEY, or pass "-" to read it from stdin; a key given here is visible in the process list.
optionDescriptions.providerCatalogDefaultModel: Mark the imported model as default_model after import.
optionDescriptions.providerCatalogBaseUrl: Override the catalog endpoint. Required when the catalog declares none (or an env placeholder).

auto_session_title.title: AI session titles
auto_session_title.description: Generate concise session titles from the conversation through the managed chat_title tool: clients auto-generate once the first turn completes and offer on-demand regeneration in the rename field.

lsp.title: LSP tool
lsp.description: Expose the Lsp tool for go-to-definition, find-references, hover, and document-symbol queries. Language servers are resolved from PATH by file type (TypeScript, Rust, Python); there is no [lsp] config section.

micro_compaction.title: Micro compaction (cache-miss tool-result truncation)
micro_compaction.description: After a prompt-cache miss, replace old oversized tool results in the outgoing request with a marker so the rebuilt prefix stays small.

persistence_minidb_readmodel.title: minidb read model
persistence_minidb_readmodel.description: Use the minidb-backed IQueryStore as a derived read model for session indexing and wire replay.

remote-control.title: Remote Control
remote-control.description: Expose the local web UI through Kimi Remote Control (`kimi web --remote-control`, `/remote-control`).

search_worker.title: search worker isolation
search_worker.description: Run the global search-index MiniDB (open, WAL replay, sync, queries) in a dedicated worker thread instead of the server main thread.

secondary-model.title: Secondary model for subagents (always on)
secondary-model.description: The subagent model pool is always on since 0.42.0; this entry is kept only so a stored [experimental] secondary-model = false still documents the retired opt-out.

subagent_backends.title: External subagent backends
subagent_backends.description: Enables the claude-code / codex / acp backends for the Agent tool, which spawn external agent CLIs instead of in-process subagents.

subagent_fork.title: Fork context for subagents
subagent_fork.description: Let the Agent and AgentSwarm tools start a subagent with a snapshot of the calling agent's conversation history via the fork parameter.

tool_select.title: Tool select (progressive tool disclosure)
tool_select.description: Keep MCP tool schemas out of the immutable top-level tools[]; the model loads them on demand via the select_tools tool. Only takes effect on models whose capability catalog declares dynamically loaded tools.

tower.title: Tower mode
tower.description: Enable tower mode: coordinate multiple agents on a shared objective, toggled with the /tower command.

xunfei_coding_plan.title: Astron (Xunfei coding plan)
xunfei_coding_plan.description: Show the Astron provider settings in /settings and enable the Astron login flow. The astron entry under [providers] stays functional regardless of this flag.
